description:
£155 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to present this recently refurbished six-bedroom student property in the popular area of Sandyford.

Ideally located close to local amenities and just a ten-minute walk from Newcastle City Centre, the property offers convenient access to everything students need. Arranged over three floors, the ground floor comprises an entrance hall, a comfortable lounge, a spacious double bedroom and a well-appointed kitchen. The first and second floors offer a further five double bedrooms and two bathrooms, providing plenty of space for a group of students.

To arrange your viewing, contact My Property Box today!
